visual.name: plumeGanttChart
visual.description: Gantt chart with the Plume Studio look: multi-level collapsible hierarchy, task grid, reader-controlled zoom from hours to years, today line, milestones, several bars per row, dependencies with critical path, baseline versus actual, computed status, resource view, rollup of collapsed groups, custom sort order, outline numbers, bar labels and colors from your fields, and one-page plan for PDF export.
